profile.name: Scientifica 运动控制线程
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件控制组件，用于主 Scientifica 设备类的后台线程中监测位置、发起移动、跟踪移动状态、处理停止与取消请求，并通过回调通知位置或物镜状态变化，适合用于 Scientifica 位移设备的运动协调与状态轮询。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software control component used as a background thread for the main Scientifica device class. It monitors position, initiates moves, tracks move status, handles stop and cancel requests, and reports position or objective changes via callbacks for coordinating and polling Scientifica motion devices.
